- Provides example API usage for PDFs, images, and text files, including webhook and polling options.
- Clarifies security practices: API key via environment variable, no local file modification, compliant with privacy standards.

DeepRead PII Redaction 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Detects and redacts 14 types of PII (names, SSNs, credit cards, medical records, etc.) using context-aware AI instead of regex.
- Supports black bar, placeholder, and partial masking redaction styles.
- Handles PDFs (including scanned), images (PNG/JPEG), and plain text files.
- Provides audit trail, does not store raw PII, and is GDPR/HIPAA compliant.
- Includes API integration with free tier (2,000 pages/month); API key required.
- Offers language support for English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, and Arabic.
